design: Lean veteran courier with a long ridged skull, widely separated angular upper mandibles, intact four mandibles and grey-tipped long dreadlocks tied into a narrow back braid. Angular triangular metal dispatch case across one shoulder, travel harness with two different-width straps, knee wrap on one leg, high-cut short civic tunic. Right arm folded lightly across torso, left hand resting on the rigid case handle. Weathered slate skin.
